en.answer: Even in that case, the effect of a <<10642>> in the hand can be activated when that Special Summon is successful.
en.question: If both players Special Summon monsters at the same time by the effect of <<4965>>, can the effect of <<10642>> be activated?
en.title: If both players Special Summon monsters at the same time by the effect of <<4965>>, can the effect of <<10642>> be activated?

ja.answer: 「<<4965>>」の効果によって、自分と相手プレイヤーが同時にモンスターを特殊召喚した場合でも、その特殊召喚に成功した時に手札の「<<10642>>」の効果を発動する事ができます。
